name: Plane Shift

source.note: Entered for the Night Hag's spellcasting; check against the book.

components.m: a forked metal rod attuned to a plane

targets.description: you and up to eight willing creatures holding hands, or one creature you touch (Charisma save)

summary: You and up to eight willing companions travel to another plane, or you banish a creature you touch (Charisma save).
text: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence, arriving at a destination of your choice there or a random spot if you lack a destination. Alternatively, you can make a melee spell attack against an unwilling creature; on a hit it makes a Charisma saving throw or is sent to a random spot on a plane you name. In a fight, the caster (and its companions) leave the battle.
